description: A failed completion that names a parameter the model does not take is retried once without it. errors: unsupportedRequestParam(status, body) -> param or null. adjust: withoutRequestParam(body, param) -> the retried body, or null when there is nothing to retry.

errors.name: OpenAI temperature on gpt-5.5 (the reported 400)
OpenAI max_tokens on a reasoning model
errors.body: {"error":{"message":"Unsupported parameter: 'max_tokens' is not supported with this model. Use 'max_completion_tokens' instead.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"max_tokens","code":"unsupported_parameter"}}

errors.name: OpenAI reasoning_effort none on a model without it
errors.body: {"error":{"message":"Unsupported value: 'reasoning_effort' does not support 'none' with this model. Supported values are: 'low', 'medium', and 'high'.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"reasoning_effort","code":"unsupported_value"}}

errors.name: no param field: the first known name quoted in the message
errors.body: {"error":{"message":"Unsupported parameter: 'max_tokens' is not supported with this model. Use 'max_completion_tokens' instead."}}

errors.name: top-level message, double quotes
errors.body: {"message":"\"top_p\" is not supported for this model"}

errors.name: plain text body
errors.body: temperature is unsupported: `temperature` does not support 0.3

errors.name: a param that is not retryable
errors.body: {"error":{"message":"Unsupported value: 'messages[0].role' does not support 'developer' with this model.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"messages[0].role","code":"unsupported_value"}}

errors.name: an out-of-range value is a real error, not an unsupported one
errors.body: {"error":{"message":"Invalid 'temperature': decimal above maximum value. Expected a value <= 2, but got 7 instead.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"temperature","code":"decimal_above_max_value"}}

errors.name: a context overflow
errors.body: {"error":{"message":"This model's maximum context length is 128000 tokens. However, your messages resulted in 130000 tokens.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"messages","code":"context_length_exceeded"}}

errors.name: not a 400
errors.body: {"error":{"message":"Unsupported value: 'temperature' does not support 0.3 with this model.","param":"temperature","code":"unsupported_value"}}

adjust.name: max_tokens is only dropped when the replacement is already there
nothing to retry when the body does not carry it
